footnote_text: Each restricted stock unit represents a contingent right to receive one share of PRIM common stock or the cash value thereof on the date of settlement, in the Company's discretion. On November 10, 2026, the restricted stock units vested and were settled for an equal number of shares of PRIM common stock.
Withholding of common stock to satisfy reporting person's tax obligation upon the settlement of vested restricted stock units.
